name: meadow-n
setup: const __cl=document.getElementById('controls'); if(__cl) __cl.style.display='none'; subwave.worldClock.setDayFraction(0.32); subwave.jumpTo('meadow'); const c = subwave.renderer.camera; window.__pin=(window.__pin||0)+1; const tok=window.__pin; (function pin(){ if(window.__pin!==tok) return; const p=subwave.player; p.oxygen=p.oxygenCapacity; const yy=0.0, pp=0.04; p.yaw=yy; p.pitch=pp; c.setEuler(yy, pp, 0); requestAnimationFrame(pin); })();

name: meadow-graze
setup: const __cl=document.getElementById('controls'); if(__cl) __cl.style.display='none'; subwave.worldClock.setDayFraction(0.32); subwave.jumpTo('meadow'); const c = subwave.renderer.camera; window.__pin=(window.__pin||0)+1; const tok=window.__pin; (function pin(){ if(window.__pin!==tok) return; const p=subwave.player; p.oxygen=p.oxygenCapacity; if(window.__gz===undefined||window.__gzTok!==tok){window.__gz=p.position[1]-1.5; window.__gzTok=tok;} p.position[1]=window.__gz; p.prevPosition.set(p.position); p.velocity.fill(0); const yy=2.0, pp=0.10; p.yaw=yy; p.pitch=pp; c.setEuler(yy, pp, 0); requestAnimationFrame(pin); })();
